svg.title: The failed review check of a stopped holder while the lock is held
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0046. A stopped request that holds the target lock, with reviewer hints on, looks at its lock every 10 minutes. After each look that leaves the lock held, by its own pull request on any base or by another open pull request from its branch, it writes the stop's failed check run shadewright/review on the recorded head commit, unless the Git host already shows it last. Three writes are new against ADR-0045: the look no longer waits for condition ReviewCheckNotFailed, it writes when its own pull request was merged on another base, and it writes through a new installation of the repository too, settled or not, whichever pull request keeps the lock. The check can only keep that commit from merging. A refused write sets ReviewCheckNotFailed and is tried again at the next look. Not covered: a deleted request (issue 984), reads that keep failing (issue 979), a look that a stop exception takes over, a request with hints off or a handoff (logged at Info), a pause, a target branch change or a repository gone, which leave a pass in place while the lock is held, and a request whose lock nothing holds. No new read and no new grant.
svg.text: A STOPPED HOLDER LOOKS
The look leaves the lock held
By its own pull request on any base, or
by another open one from its branch.
Its own one may be open elsewhere,
closed, merged elsewhere or gone.
Every 10 minutes. Only with hints on.
WRITTEN
The stop's failed check
shadewright/review on the recorded head,
unless the Git host shows it last.
Fixed summary, promises no close;
its reason or phase is a fixed constant.
Refused: ReviewCheckNotFailed, tried
again at the next look.
EFFECT
No pass from before the stop
decides the merge
A check run belongs to the commit:
every pull request from the branch
shows it. It can only keep that
commit from merging.
NEW AGAINST ADR-0045
1. No wait for condition ReviewCheckNotFailed.
2. Own pull request merged on another base while
another open one keeps the lock.
3. Through a new installation too, settled or not,
whichever pull request keeps the lock.
NOT COVERED
Deleted request (#984). Reads that keep failing (#979).
A look a stop exception takes over writes nothing then.
Hints off or a handoff: nothing, logged at Info.
Pause, another target branch, repository gone: late.
Lock released: no look.
No new read, no new grant
The reads are ADR-0043's and ADR-0045's; checks: write is already in every token request.
Never on another base: push, comment, merge, update of title or body.
